taskVersion.name: pilot-ves-label-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Odufor, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model from the published survey:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The paper labels this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Odufor, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the paper's curve-type label does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note — Station Odufor, Etche LGA**

Four geoelectric layers were resolved to about 17 m.

- Layer 1: 20.32 ohm-m, 0.14 m — thin conductive topsoil/clayey cover.
- Layer 2: 851.16 ohm-m, 1.10 m — resistive dry sand.
- Layer 3: 2511.9 ohm-m, 15.80 m — highly resistive sand/gravel, base at 17.04 m.
- Layer 4: 1345 ohm-m, undetermined thickness — moderately resistive sand; likely the first realistic aquifer target, though resistivity remains high and no conductive saturated horizon was imaged within the surveyed depth.

Curve type: resistivities rise then fall (20.32 < 851.16 < 2511.9 > 1345), giving layers 1-2-3 = A and layers 2-3-4 = K, i.e. an **AK curve**. The published "A-type" label does not fit the tabulated values, since a pure A-type requires monotonic increase through layer 4. Recommend drilling beyond 17 m and verifying the model before casing design.

{"curve_type_stated": "AK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
